record.name: Discord
record.one_liner: A communications platform allowing users to interact via voice, video, and text across servers and channels.
record.access_note: Developers can sign up and create applications for free in the Discord Developer Portal.
record.api_note: The Discord API is a REST API that allows you to interact with Discord data from your own applications.

evidence.quote: Authenticating with the Discord API can be done in one of three ways:
Build bots and integrations on Discord, or connect your game with rich presence, voice chat, and more.
The Discord API is a REST API that allows you to interact with Discord data from your own applications.
A production-grade Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Discord built with FastMCP and discord.py.
